source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.3

data.summary: Whenever a melee attack **destroys** one of this unit's models that has yet to fight this phase, roll a D6. On a 4+, leave it on the battlefield: it can fight once the attacking unit has finished its attacks, then it is removed.
